fields.System.Title: OUT-206 — Deallocate an order line
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to release an allocation without cancelling the order, so that
stock can be redirected to a more urgent order.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an allocated line not yet picked, when I deallocate it, then its reservations
  • are released and the line returns to unallocated.
  • - Given a line already picked, then deallocation is rejected.
  • - Given deallocation, then the stock immediately becomes available to other orders.
  • - Given deallocation, then the reason and the acting user are recorded.
  • - Given the line, then it can be reallocated afterwards.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | allocation, reservation, stock_balance |
| Risks | Reservation not fully released ([doc 09 §5.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
